status: Synthetic development calibration with automated model grading.
claim_scope: Exploratory skill effect for one Codex/model/effort configuration; not representative workplace effectiveness or model-general evidence.

conditions.no_skill: Common task instructions and task data only.
conditions.short_prompt: Self-contained compact adaptation of this skill, including EN/DE safeguards; not a generic plain-writing prompt.
conditions.full_skill: Current repository skill and case-selected references, injected by the harness.

generation_rules: Same cases, requests, model, effort and controls in every condition.
Fresh isolated session per sample; execution order randomized with recorded seed.
Private checks and answer keys are not included in generation prompts.
Freeze suite, compact text, candidate skill, selected references, profile and answer keys before generation; record hashes.
Ordinary task requirements and source facts are common to all conditions; editorial coaching that repeated hidden rubric safeguards was removed from rough notes before freezing.

model_grading.fidelity: For every output, assess each supplied requirement against the source/notes. Record a pass or fail with concrete evidence for every criterion. Check unsupported claims beyond the criteria and flag weak or incomplete evaluation criteria.
model_grading.preference: Compare all three condition pairs under anonymous A/B labels in fresh sessions, once in each presentation order. Allow ties. Assess clarity, idiomatic language, audience/register fit, remaining editing burden and concrete defects. Keep semantic fidelity separate. Disagreement between presentation orders is inconclusive.
model_grading.answerability: Each fresh answering session receives one output and its questions only, excluding source, other variants, keys, run artifacts and decoding.
model_grading.answer_scoring: Separate scoring sessions compare recorded answers with private answer keys and record correct/partial/incorrect/unanswerable with reasons. Recorded answers alone are not correctness scores.
model_grading.provenance: Record grading prompts, raw responses, requested and reported model/settings, schema validation failures and run/input hashes separately from the generation artifact.
model_grading.use: Model grading is advisory evidence for skill development; it does not impose a CI threshold. Deterministic repository and execution checks retain their own failure status.
excluded_criteria: Word or punctuation counts as universal quality proxies
Assuming the longest or shortest output is best

acceptance_for_pilot: Every expected sample is accounted for, including failures and unevaluated literal checks.
Anonymous pair labels, reversed presentation orders and separation of answer keys from answering sessions are checked.
Grading responses satisfy their schemas and provide evidence or reasons for their judgments; failed grading calls remain visible.
Fix procedural defects before expanding to sanitized real tasks and a frozen held-out set.
limits: All cases are synthetic and visible to the author.
All cases are development; none is held out.
One generation per condition/case does not estimate sampling variance.
The full condition tests controlled injection, not automatic skill discovery.
Single-model findings do not establish transfer to other models.
Literal-anchor passes do not establish semantic fidelity or writing quality.
Model answerability measures information recoverable by the grading model, not readership outcomes.
The grading model is also the generation model; fresh contexts and anonymous labels do not eliminate shared model biases.
The compact candidate condenses the main skill plus selected branch safeguards; differences cannot be attributed to token length or reference-file layout alone.

reference_routing.en-support-decision: messages.md covers decision requests, stated timing and uncertainties for the business audience; technical.md was removed as an unnecessary procedure/code branch.
